resolved_v2_findings.scope: Original full paired Jobs/LocalIdentityReplies/Store/full ACK public synthetic scenario; next-turn status question now bypasses the sampler.

The same exact actor/meta/request, original 120-second deadline still live, now rechecks status instead of returning stale positive. The original write replay and fingerprint mismatch refusal also pass.

cleanup_concurrency_review.worker_scope: _run and queued _clear_status_receipt execute on the existing max_workers=1 executor. _call queues metadata cleanup without waiting on that worker. No new nested wait or new mutex order is introduced.
cleanup_concurrency_review.late_cleanup_boundary: The cleanup key is (boot,session). It removes only an existing receipt whose generation <= the failed request generation. A later same-actor generation is retained; a different actor is untouched.
cleanup_concurrency_review.independent_test: test_receipt_cleanup_boundaries.py creates three genuine synthetic identity commits with fake orthogonal vectors, then executes delayed old-generation cleanup on the same worker. It preserves the higher-generation receipt and the other actor receipt. Matching-generation cleanup removes only RAM metadata; all three identity rows remain; a still-valid other-actor receipt remains queryable.
cleanup_concurrency_review.lock_boundary: Original ownership RLock is released before is_current callback evaluation; no new lock spans future.result or metadata cleanup. Existing guarded identity transaction ownership and actual durable rows are unchanged.
cleanup_concurrency_review.reset_boundary: reset deliberately clears all transient receipts with existing session reset. This is a global reset path, not a claim that any old request may clear a later unrelated actor.
cleanup_concurrency_review.limits: Targeted deterministic synthetic ordering and source review; not a hardware, prolonged race stress, or full GUI deployment acceptance.

session_and_revision_semantics: The existing actual paired commit/full ACK/next-generation query scenario still passes. Session ownership is not reduced to one job generation.

Receipt uses the speaker identity/template revision, not timeline appends or general database mtime. A later real identity commit intentionally makes older-version status unknown; this is distinct from deleting its receipt.
Queries remain read-only and grant no profile permissions. A committed identity is not undone by later UI cancellation.
